decisions.reason: As a close-to-core support component that uses existing fabrication capabilities and serves current customers, it would likely be retained unless its sales clearly fall below aspiration levels.

This single-model public waste bin is relatively distant from the core pipeline business, so without clear evidence of strong results it is the most likely candidate for redeploying resources back to established activities or other development.

The waste-bin-with-ashtray line appears more developed than a one-off item and can still leverage coating, metalworking, and municipal customer access, so with some slack we would keep it while monitoring performance.

Outdoor public ashtrays are non-core but complementary to the public-space product line and inexpensive to carry with existing resources, so we would keep them for now despite meaningful withdrawal risk if outcomes stay below aspiration.
